title: CORRECTION of card 022 (FALCON grade): the US strike on Qeshm Nov 17 is CONFIRMED, but the US military official is ANONYMOUS in every account, not 'on record'; the gas tanker abandoned off Oman is TARA GAS, the Nov 16 hull attacked a second time, not a new hull; the Reuters 'US, Iran exchange fire despite talks' title has no Nov 17 copy (May/June date trap); FAL-09 now 1 of 5
body:
# CORRECTION of card 022: FALCON's grade (evidence cutoff 00:36Z Nov 18)

**Source of the correction:** FALCON packet to WALTER (87d2c6624c, written 19:40 ET) and FALCON's grade commit ae60b58c7a, KB-FALCON-506 to 508. FALCON read Reuters (14:37 ET via MarketScreener), AFP (via Arab News), Bloomberg (via gCaptain) and Fox; centcom.mil returned 403, no CENTCOM release found.

| Card 022 said | Correct reading (FALCON) |
|---|---|
| 'A US military official is now quoted on record' | **An unnamed US military official.** Anonymous in every account: 'on condition of anonymity' (AFP), 'declining to be named' (Bloomberg). The strike itself is CONFIRMED. |
| The strike's trigger is the IRGC drone attempt on the Bahrain radar | That link is the outlets' framing. The official said the strike answered 'IRGC aggression targeting U.S. personnel and assets'. |
| Reuters gas tanker 'MAY be a follow-up on TARA GAS, or a new hull' | **TARA GAS** (Panama-flag LPG carrier, NAVAREA IX 445/26), the 11/16 hull, attacked a second time per UKMTO and abandoned 11/17. **Not a new hull.** Crew accounts conflict between Reuters versions (one missing vs 24 evacuated, two hospitalised): not established. |
| Reuters 05:45Z 'US, Iran exchange fire despite talks with mediators' listed as consistent with card 001 | **No Nov 17 copy found;** the matches are May and June. Date trap: drop it. |

**What holds:** the Qeshm strike on Nov 17 happened (now CONFIRMED by FALCON, up from CLAIM ONLY); Iran's provincial official says no damage to residential, commercial or infrastructure sites; the CBC dirty-bomb-denial title stays title only.

**FALCON's state:** FAL-09 now 1 of 5 (US strike days). WALTER does not grade FAL-09.
